object_context: Strict child of C024. Construct or refute a correlation-sensitive lift of semi-filter packing for unrestricted Cavalar-Oliveira cover complexity that restores simultaneous consistency across multiple integral pair/fusion choices, retains a proved bounded per-fusion budget, recovers the logarithmic G_NEQ calibration, and still leaves room for an omega(log N) lower bound on some explicit full-cover target.
structural_coordinates: cover complexity is an integral set cover over pair vertices versus semi-filter vertices and equals cyclic intersection complexity
C024's fractional LP has a sound one-pair budget but loses simultaneous integrality/correlation across pair choices
G_NEQ has exact cover complexity log_2 N and its Proposition 40 proof recursively normalizes pairs to disjoint complementary partitions
a selected family of k normalized cuts induces at most 2^k joint binary signatures on distinguished generator traces
canonical-cover information is globally logarithmically bounded by C009 and cannot by itself yield the required super-log full-cover lower bound
the surviving target must depend on higher-order semi-filter/closure correlations rather than only independent weights or first-order generator labels
any lifted relaxation must preserve a legal per-fusion charging law and survive C010 multiplexing, C013 quotient, C021 cheap-adjacency, C023 scalar-collapse, and C024 integrality-gap adversaries
equivalent_formulations: strengthen the cover-graph LP with joint consistency constraints across several selected pair vertices
define an information/entropy certificate for the simultaneous pattern induced by an integral family of fusion pairs
calibrate whether joint binary signatures of distinguished generator traces recover the G_NEQ logarithmic lower bound
determine whether every generator-signature-only lift has an O(log N) capacity ceiling and therefore must be replaced by higher-order semi-filter closure state
search for a lifted packing whose target value can be omega(log N) while one legal fusion changes the certificate by O(1)
solved_analogues: Cavalar-Oliveira Proposition 40: rho(G_NEQ)=log_2 N by recursively normalizing covering pairs and halving the surviving row/column universe
C009: canonical cover complexity is globally at most logarithmic, so canonical/generator-separation state cannot be the final super-log invariant
near_solved_analogues: Karchmer-Kushilevitz-Nisan 1995 fractional-cover LP methods in communication complexity, including limits of fractional relaxations for stronger deterministic/formula lower bounds
Chlamtac-Friggstad-Georgiou 2012 set-cover lift-and-project analysis: strong generic consistency hierarchies can retain logarithmic integrality gaps without additional structure

method_transfers.source_context: Cavalar-Oliveira 2025 Proposition 40 lower bound for G_NEQ
method_transfers.method: normalize each covering pair on the canonical G_NEQ witness family to a disjoint complementary partition, then reason about the joint information supplied by the entire integral family rather than one fractional pair at a time
shared_structure: the target object is the same cover graph and the same integral family of pair vertices
the obstruction is simultaneous coverage of many semi-filters
each selected normalized pair supplies one binary partition coordinate on the G_NEQ diagonal witness universe
required_assumptions: the normalization lemmas used for G_NEQ canonical semi-filters apply only inside that calibration
coverage is evaluated for an integral family of pairs chosen simultaneously
disanalogies: the G_NEQ normalization exploits the special canonical semi-filter geometry and does not represent arbitrary full semi-filters
recovering log N on G_NEQ is only a calibration floor, not evidence of a super-log full-cover invariant
method_transfers.repair_question: What higher-order state survives outside G_NEQ once first-order binary generator signatures are shown to have only logarithmic capacity?
source_anchors: Cavalar-Oliveira, Boolean Circuit Complexity and Two-Dimensional Cover Problems, ECCC TR25-033, Definition 21 and Proposition 40

method_transfers.source_context: fractional set cover and lift-and-project consistency hierarchies
method_transfers.method: repair an integrality gap by adding joint marginals/consistency constraints over multiple choices before attempting target-specific optimization
shared_structure: C024 is a set-cover LP relaxation with a logarithmic calibration gap
the missing coordinate is compatibility among several choices rather than feasibility of each local choice separately
lifted variables can encode correlations absent from first-order marginals
required_assumptions: the lifted constraints correspond to real simultaneous pair choices in the cover graph
a per-fusion lower-bound accounting rule remains provable after lifting
disanalogies: generic Sherali-Adams/Lovasz-Schrijver hierarchy behavior does not determine the bespoke semi-filter cover graph
known set-cover hierarchy gaps are algorithmic integrality-gap results, not circuit lower bounds
method_transfers.repair_question: Which minimum-order consistency coordinate is specific enough to the semi-filter preservation law to escape generic set-cover logarithmic gaps?
source_anchors: Karchmer, Kushilevitz, Nisan, Fractional Covers and Communication Complexity, SIAM J. Discrete Math. 8(1), 1995
Chlamtac, Friggstad, Georgiou, Understanding Set Cover: Sub-exponential Time Approximations and Lift-and-Project Methods, arXiv:1204.5489

method_transfers.source_context: binary separating codes / elementary information counting
method_transfers.method: represent each selected binary test by one signature coordinate and use the number of distinct joint signatures as an exact capacity bound
shared_structure: an integral family of k normalized cuts is simultaneously applied to a fixed witness universe
objects that must be separated by some chosen cut need distinct joint signatures
k binary coordinates realize at most 2^k distinguishable signatures
required_assumptions: the candidate certificate depends only on a fixed polynomial-size set of distinguished traces and pairwise separation of their signatures
each selected pair contributes at most one binary coordinate to that representation
disanalogies: full semi-filter preservation depends on membership of arbitrary subsets of U and their intersections, not merely identities of original generator traces
a high-order closure-state certificate may have an exponentially larger effective state space and is not covered by the first-order signature capacity bound
method_transfers.repair_question: Can an exact higher-order closure signature be defined whose per-fusion information increase is bounded but whose state capacity is super-logarithmic in graph side size?
source_anchors: elementary pigeonhole/counting principle for binary signatures
Cavalar-Oliveira 2025 Claim 41 and Lemmas 42-43 inside Proposition 40

explicit_disanalogies: restoring joint consistency is not sufficient by itself: a low-order signature representation can still have only logarithmic information capacity
generic lift-and-project hierarchy strength does not transfer automatically to the semi-filter cover graph
G_NEQ is a calibration witness, not a candidate hard family for super-log cover complexity
canonical semi-filters and unrestricted semi-filters are distinct; C009 already closes the super-log canonical lane
cross-Millennium failures currently on main provide representation warnings but no target-applicable P-vs-NP theorem or reusable lower-bound tool

cross_domain_analogies.source_situation: A collection of k binary checks assigns every object a joint k-bit badge; pairwise conflicts can be resolved only when conflicting objects receive different badges, so at most 2^k identities can be distinguished.
common_abstraction: many simultaneous obligations share a common family of binary decisions
local decisions compose into a joint signature
capacity of the representation, not local validity of each decision, limits what can be distinguished
source_to_target_mapping: binary check -> normalized integral cover pair in the G_NEQ calibration
object identity -> distinguished generator trace/diagonal witness
conflict requiring different badges -> canonical semi-filter requiring some selected pair to separate its two witnesses
number of badge bits -> number of selected fusion pairs
shared_constraints: the same selected decisions must work simultaneously for all obligations
a coordinate is shared globally rather than chosen separately for each obligation
disanalogies: general semi-filters contain arbitrary subsets and preservation constraints, not only pairwise identity conflicts
a full-cover certificate may require higher-order closure relations that cannot be compressed into badges on original traces
cross_domain_analogies.proposed_principle: Use joint-signature capacity as the first correlation-restoring calibration after C024, then deliberately try to prove that this repair is still too low-order before investing in a hierarchy.
cross_domain_analogies.validation_obligation: After the strict gate passes, derive the exact G_NEQ signature lower bound from Proposition 40 normalization and then prove or refute an O(log N) capacity ceiling for every certificate that depends only on polynomially many generator-wise binary signatures.
cross_domain_analogies.provenance_note: Proposal-only structural analogy. It supplies no graph-cover lower-bound authority.

analogy_scan_notes: Scanned set-cover hierarchies, communication complexity, coding/separating systems, and cross-Millennium representation failures. Retained only the joint-signature capacity bridge because it has an exact G_NEQ mapping and an immediate hostile capacity test.
